author: cjfromgrove
quote:
Worst starting scene from any gta prior, worst story from any gta prior.
Worst performance from any gta prior, game runs under 30fps on a ps5 pro, a regular ps5 is unplayable.
Can't shoot/do specific things because of ''politic reasons'', this is a game thats litteraly all about violence/theft and as the name says ''grand theft auto'', you can't even steal some cars as example: you can't steal cars from your neighbourhood.
This isn't gta, its completely against its own identity.
This game feels like it was made with AI in india, with the direction/story made by liberal blue haired women.
Even the main characters feel completely whack, you can't compare them to ANY of the previous gta characters.
Maybe the online version with alot of mods that will remove/fix those issues will make it better when it comes out for pc, but as it stands this game is a complete flop, and it only sold as many copies as it did, purely because of the hype of being the ''next big gta'' after gta5, all you had to do was make the same game with higher graphics and you would have game of the year, but instead you will have the most refunded game to this date.
Sad to see such a iconic game be destroyed, by incompetent people with no passion for making games or gaming in general, you should keep politics outside games.
